title: YMCA Connections Snapshot: third places and belonging
discussion_signal: The post describes weak community connection among young adults and positions YMCA spaces as third places where people of different ages and backgrounds build belonging. A personal reaction describes how such a space shaped connection, work, and identity, adding lived meaning to the survey framing.
linked_research_question: How do affordable third places convert social isolation into belonging, trust, and durable community connection?
limits: Survey promotion and one self-selected personal account
The post does not provide the full survey methodology
A single YMCA experience cannot establish population-level effects
